definitions.explanation: A shelf located in the upper part of a cabinet, closet, or storage unit. Used especially of the overhead luggage rack on trains and buses.

examples.japanese: {上棚|うわだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put my luggage on the upper shelf.

examples.japanese: {上棚|うわだな}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重|おも}くて→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: The box on the top shelf is too heavy to take down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上棚|うわだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧カバン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I left my bag on the overhead rack of the train.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{上|うわ}→上〜：00416_uwa⟧ (upper) + ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (shelf), with ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ voicing to だな in compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上棚|うわだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to place on the upper shelf
- {上棚|うわだな}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take down from the upper shelf
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上棚|うわだな}: overhead rack on a train

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下棚|したな}: lower shelf — the opposite position
- ⟦{網棚|あみだな}→網棚：10195_amidana⟧: overhead luggage rack (specifically the mesh rack on trains) — more specific than {上棚|うわだな}
